summary: Cameco filed a Form 6-K with a July 1, 2026 press release disclosing a temporary suspension of operations at its Cigar Lake mine due to a sulfuric acid plant issue at Orano's McClean Lake mill. The suspension is expected to last about two weeks with no anticipated impact on 2026 production outlook, though a longer disruption poses a risk. No merger, acquisition, tender offer, or strategic transaction is involved; this is an operational update. The filing is a routine foreign private issuer report under the Exchange Act and does not meet any special-situations category.
